value: one file/tab per (scenario, cluster) - see Selection's 'tab' (xlsx) or 'csv_file' (csv) column for the mapping. Each one has the 8760-hour series (gross/net/pv_generation and every included end-use) as raw per-customer kWh, plus a '<series>_normalized' column next to each one, scaled to sum to 1 over the year.
sum of non-excluded end-use columns, each mode-adjusted (average = raw cluster value; typical = raw value / that row's own penetration for that end use) before any per-customer/absolute scaling
gross - pv_generation (pv_generation is always a credit, never a selectable end-use)
reported as its own column, not folded into gross or net
see the EndUseModes sheet - the exact mode and penetration used for every (scenario, cluster, end_use) row, AFTER any global overrides were applied

each '<series>_normalized' column is independently scaled to sum to 1 by its OWN total. gross = net + pv_generation, and gross_excl_X = gross - X's contribution, hold on the raw kWh columns but NOT across normalized columns - they are separate shapes, not related magnitudes, once normalized.
